sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Presses Skip for you on the parts you choose: Apple's promos for other titles, recaps, and intros.
Stops Apple's usage metrics, such as the pages you view and what you play.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Stops the review prompt from Google Play in the Android TV app.
Stops the ad interstitials in on-demand videos.
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
